data.intro: I'm Gustavs, aka mrgrass. I game, take photos, flip gear and build software, and I'm learning all of it in public.
data.bio:
I'm Gustavs, better known online as mrgrass. I spend my time on three things: gaming (mostly CS2 and Forza, with Minecraft when I want something relaxed), photography, and buying, fixing and reselling things.

I only picked up a camera recently, so the Photography page is a learning diary: everything I've shot so far, edited or not. On the software side I build tools I want for myself, like SS.lv Deal Finder, which spots underpriced electronics on Latvia's biggest classifieds site.
goals: Find a lens in the €100 to €200 range
Edit the rest of my photos and publish them here
Add a goals tab and Telegram alerts to Deal Finder
